label: Activity feed
description: The conversation on a record: public replies that the requester sees and internal work notes that only agents see, in one timeline with a composer. Internal notes are never visible to requesters or portal users and are never included in notifications sent to them. Comment bodies are rich text, sanitized on the server.
usage: Place one feed per record view, usually in the first tab of a tab group or the main column.
Keep defaultComposer internal on agent views so a reply to the requester is a deliberate choice.
Turn showInternal off only on views meant for requester-facing contexts.
constraints: Internal notes are never returned to requesters or portal users by any API and never included in their notifications.
showInternal has no effect for viewers without internal-note access; they only see and post public replies.
Bodies are rich text sanitized on every write like field.rich_text; entries are append-only and edits are kept in audit history.
defaultComposer must be a visibility the feed shows.

binding.description: Reads and appends activity entries of the page's record, filtered by the viewer's audience.

accessibility.keyboard: PageUp/PageDown move between entries; C focuses the composer; Alt+I switches public/internal; Ctrl/Cmd+Enter posts.
accessibility.notes: Each entry is an article labelled by author, audience, and time. Internal notes say "Internal" in text, not only with the accent.amber edge; the composer states who will see the post.

responsive: On phones the composer sticks to the bottom of the screen and expands when focused.

examples.description: Agent feed defaulting to internal notes
